# MJP Hero

> A free, offline issue-spotting tool for lawyers practicing across state lines (multijurisdictional practice / MJP). Answer 14 questions and get a recommendation citing ABA Model Rule 5.5, ABA Model Rule 8.5, ABA Formal Opinions 495, 498, 504, and 88-356, and sourced state rules for all 50 states and D.C..

Not legal advice. Runs entirely in the browser with no network access (enforced by CSP) and no data storage; nothing a user enters ever leaves the tab.

## Primary page
- [MJP Hero](https://nkostelnik.github.io/mjp-hero/): the issue-spotter tool.
